# The adversarial review — stopped early

Six reviewers were launched over the deliverables at 11:25 PM ET on 2026-11-11, two at a time: numbers against the
raw outputs; Eve code citations; kernel and standing rulings; format soundness; completeness against the research
plan; the plan itself. At 11:33 PM ET the operator reported the weekly quota nearly spent and the pass was stopped.

Only the first two had started, about six minutes each. What they banked is in `R1-numbers.md` (2 findings) and
`R2-eve-code.md` (3 findings) — both PARTIAL. All five were checked against the raw outputs and the source and
fixed in the deliverables. A script then compared every figure in `MEASUREMENTS.md` with the committed raw outputs:
the M4 table was the only block transcribed from another run.

The four lenses that did not run are listed in `IMPL-PLAN.md` R11 and `STATUS.md`.
